definitions.gloss: wealthy class, affluent people, the rich
definitions.explanation: The segment of the population with substantial financial assets and high income. Used in economic, sociological, and media contexts to describe the upper economic bracket.

examples.japanese: {富裕層|ふゆうそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{富裕層|ふゆうそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: Many affluent people live in this area.

examples.japanese: {富裕層|ふゆうそう}{向|む}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Luxury condominiums targeting the wealthy are being built one after another.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
{富裕|ふゆう} (wealthy, affluent) + ⟦{層|そう}→層：12441_sou⟧ (class, stratum, layer).

USAGE:
{富裕層|ふゆうそう} is a neutral, analytical term used in news, economics, and marketing. It is not pejorative. In Japan, the term is commonly defined by the financial industry as households with financial assets exceeding 100 million yen ({一億円|いちおくえん}).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧: rich person (everyday, informal)
- ⟦{資産家|しさんか}→資産家：16291_shisanka⟧: person of means, wealthy person
- {上流階級|じょうりゅうかいきゅう}: upper class (focuses on social status)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {富裕層|ふゆうそう}{向|む}け: targeting the wealthy
- ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧{富裕層|ふゆうそう}: ultra-wealthy class
- {富裕層|ふゆうそう}⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧: business catering to the affluent
